ruleDefinitions.name: PUA - WebBrowserPassView Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of WebBrowserPassView.exe. A password recovery tool that reveals the passwords stored by the following Web browsers, Internet Explorer (Version 4.0 - 11.0), Mozilla Firefox (All Versions), Google Chrome, Safari, and Opera

sequences.query: (process_description = "Web\ Browser\ Password\ Viewer" OR process_path = RGX("\\\\WebBrowserPassView\\\.exe$"))
